# Neev: Private Indian Family Operating System and Multi-Generational Sanctuary

> Production Site: https://neev.devamit.co.in
> AnvayKosh Ecosystem Application: com.amit.neev
> Systems Architect: Amit Chakraborty (https://amitchakraborty.dev)

## Technical Architecture & Core Capabilities
- Multi-generational family schedule coordination and shared parenting rhythms.
- Cultural heirloom archiving with zero-knowledge encryption.
- Offline spatial radar and emergency safe zone maps.
- All sensitive data processed 100% locally on user hardware.
- Cryptographic isolation backed by device Keystore AES-256 GCM encryption.
- Zero commercial data brokers, zero third-party telemetry SDKs, and zero advertisement networks.
